{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Identify completed orders
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'

# Define target population: completed and not internal test
target_mask = completed_mask & ~internal_test_mask

# Filter the data
filtered_df = df[target_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = filtered_df['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print only the required values: total revenue and size of filtered group
print(f"Total revenue: {total_revenue:.2f}")
print(f"Number of completed orders excluding internal test: {len(filtered_df)}")"}
